name: Alt2Obsidian
description: Import Alt (altalt.io) lecture notes into Obsidian as page-anchored markdown, straight from the Alt app on this computer (read only) or from a share URL. Transcripts are aligned to slides by their timestamps. Per-slide commentary from your Claude Code or Codex CLI (a lecture without slides gets a transcript section summary note, or you attach its PDF), hash-augmented markers preserve your callouts across re-imports, a built-in Synced Viewer scrolls the PDF and notes in lockstep, and your own notes (a Notion export, a Notion page through your Notion MCP, or pasted text) can be checked against the slides and transcript.
author: BiQnT
